text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-President Hrawi calls on "Arab brothers" to fulfill their promises and give Lebanon promised financial aid. Donor countries announced during the "Friends of Lebanon" conference, held in Washington on December 16, over $3 billion in aid to Lebanon.

-U.S. Assistant Secretary of State for Near Eastern Affairs Pelletreau says "Friends of Lebanon" conference was successful and the U.S. travel ban on Lebanon will be under active revision by Secretary of State Christopher.
-The Arab League's secretary-general says: "Any Israeli attempt to isolate Lebanon will fail".
-Prime Minister Hariri says Lebanon will not disarm the pro-Iranian Hizbollah before a full Israeli withdrawal.
-Parliament Speaker Berri chaired a four-hour children's parliament session.
-The ministry of industry and oil increased by 600 Lebanese pounds ($0.39) the price of a 10-kg gas cylinder to 9,400 pounds ($6.05).
-Russian ambassador to Lebanon Peressypkine proposed to Lebanese official a bilateral cultural agreement.
-Israeli warplanes launched morning and evening rounds of air raids against suspected guerrilla targets in south Lebanon.
